newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT CLOSE SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT CLOSE SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores of Supersport cricket series matches on Sunday:
In Durban (day two): Griqualand West 91 and 18-1, Natal 413-3 delared (Derek Crookes 128 not out, Dale Benkenstein 101 not out, Errol Stewart 82, Doug Watson 52).
In Bloemfontein (day two): Free State 401 (Kosie Venter 101, Deon Jordaan 68), Border 321-5 (Piet Botha 136, Peter Kirsten 56, Mark Boucher 53 not out).
In Paarl (day one): Boland 204 (Kenny Jackson 120), Eastern Province 30-4.
